The structure of Li4Co2S4 (reduced formula Li2CoS2) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 194), with a unit cell containing 10 atoms distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies tetrahedral coordination for both Co and Li centers, each surrounded by four S neighbors, while each S center has two Co and two Li geometric neighbors. These tetrahedra connect through corner-sharing patterns, including Co–Li and Li–Li pairs, and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
